defect: duckdb_to_arrow_schema reinterprets the duckdb_logical_type* array of opaque handles as an array of LogicalType objects (types_array[i]), reading handle pointers as LogicalType values.
reason: The fix replaces exactly this added cast with a per-element dereference of each handle, and the line survived unchanged from this change to the fix.

defect: The uncommented templated_delete and templated_less_scan bodies allocate Keys with `*new Key(...)` that are never freed, leaking memory on every delete and range scan.
reason: The fix replaces these `*new Key` allocations (including the ones this change activated) with make_unique, so part of the repaired leak lies in lines this change added.

defect: The change moves assert(info->chunk) and assert(info->tuple_data) into Cleanup and applies them unconditionally to DELETE and UPDATE entries, although in Cleanup info->chunk is null for superseded versions (handled by the else branch right below), so debug builds abort.
reason: The fix moves exactly these asserts inside the indexes branch; the unconditional asserts in Cleanup for UPDATE_TUPLE were introduced by this change.

defect: IsTriviallyMappable returns true for any found leaf column before checking expected_idx and the type, so reordered or retyped struct children (and retyped top-level columns) are treated as trivially mappable, skipping remap_struct and filter casts.
reason: The fix removes exactly the early `children.empty()` return added by this change.

defect: The BaseScanner constructor dereferences cur_buffer_handle->Ptr() before checking it, although CSVBufferManager::GetBuffer can return nullptr (the D_ASSERT comes after the dereference).
reason: The fix guards exactly this added dereference for a null buffer handle; seeing that GetBuffer can return null needs csv_buffer_manager.cpp, and the trigger (an iterator past the last buffer) came with later code.

defect: GenerateStateMachineSearchSpace always uses the sniffed DetectNewLineDelimiter() result and drops the old SetNewLine check that kept a user-specified new_line option.
reason: The fix restores the IsSetByUser check around exactly the line this change added, and the user new_line option already existed at the change.

defect: The generated enum util code declares and uses duckdb::DictionaryAppendState, but the enum lives in namespace duckdb::dict_fsst, so DictionaryAppendState::REGULAR etc. do not resolve and the build fails.
reason: The fix removes exactly the include and the DictionaryAppendState specializations added here and blacklists the enum in the generator; the namespace is only visible in dict_fsst/common.hpp.

defect: SortKeyRecomputeHeapPointers sets each sort key's data pointer to the new heap pointer itself, ignoring old_heap_ptrs, so when the caller passes per-part base heap pointers (as InitializeChunkStateInternal does) all keys point to the part start.
reason: The fix replaces the added assignment with the old/new pointer difference computation that the regular path in the same function already uses.

defect: The change counts probe matches in the member probe_sel_count of the PerfectHashJoinExecutor, which is shared by all threads probing the join and is never reset, so the count races and accumulates across chunks.
reason: The fix turns probe_sel_count into a per-call local, repairing the shared-state counter this change introduced; that the executor is shared across threads is only visible in physical_hash_join and the header.

defect: Decorrelation of CTE_REF uses cteref.types.size() (the resolved types, only populated by ResolveOperatorTypes) as the correlated column offset and pushes correlated types into types/setop.types, giving wrong bindings and duplicated types.
reason: The fix switches to chunk_types.size() and drops the pushes into types that this change added; knowing that types is the derived resolved list needs logical_operator/logical_cteref.

defect: GetDate computes timestamp / MICROS_PER_DAY - (timestamp < 0), which is off by one day for negative timestamps that are exact multiples of a day (GetTime then returns 24:00:00).
reason: The fix corrects exactly this floor-division expression added by the change.

defect: The fix swaps free() for delete in the new test's cleanup of out_names (allocated with new[]) and of names[0] (allocated with strdup).
reason: This is a test-only change, and the swap is itself no correct repair (strdup memory is now deleted and new[] memory is still not freed with delete[]), so no product defect is fixed.

defect: The new PythonFilesystem::RemoveDirectory calls fsspec rmdir, which only removes empty directories, while DuckDB's RemoveDirectory contract is a recursive removal.
reason: The fix replaces exactly this added call with rm(recursive=True); the recursive contract is defined by the FileSystem/LocalFileSystem implementation in another file.

defect: SHOW TABLES now queries only duckdb_tables() and returns a column named table_name, dropping the views and indexes and the name column that the sqlite_master query returned.
reason: The fix rewrites exactly this added query to union tables, views and indexes under the column name, restoring the previous behaviour within the current catalog.

defect: ExtractAggregationStats uses grouping-set entries (indexes into aggr.groups) directly as indexes into the child's column_distinct_count, which can be out of range (assert/out-of-bounds read) or pick the wrong column.
reason: The fix maps each group index through its BoundColumnRefExpression binding, repairing the lookup this change added; knowing grouping_sets hold group indexes needs LogicalAggregate.

defect: The whole-group prefetch check keys on have_prefetched_group/prefetched_group (a per-file row group index) that InitializeScan never resets, so when the scan state moves to another file the same group index is taken as already prefetched and the prefetch is skipped.
reason: The fix resets have_prefetched_group at every row group switch and drops the prefetched_group comparison that this change activated; at the change the skip fell back to direct reads, and with the later fallback it hit D_ASSERT.

defect: The change asserts that the left and right children of a semi/anti join have the same number of column bindings, which fails in debug builds whenever the two sides differ in width.
reason: The fix removes exactly this added D_ASSERT (explaining the sizes can differ); the anti-join right pushdown it also stops predates this change.

defect: pragma_last_profiling_output reports the query text and elapsed time from context.query and context.profiler (the current pragma query) while the operators come from prev_profiler.
reason: The fix switches exactly this added line to prev_profiler, and the inconsistency is visible within the new function.

defect: ParquetProgress divides a chunk count accumulated over all files by the first file's row count, so multi-file scans report progress far above 100 percent.
reason: The fix resets the chunk count per file and scales by the file index, repairing the progress formula added here; the scan loop in the same diff shows the reader moving to further files.

defect: Pivot enum names are built from the local pivot_entries.size(), but AddPivotEntry forwards entries to the parent transformer, so in child transformers the count stays 0 and two pivots get the same enum name, which REPLACE_ON_CONFLICT then silently overwrites.
reason: The fix replaces exactly this added naming with a parent-aware PivotEntryCount(); the previous UUID-based name, removed here, was unique.

defect: The new PIVOT select form is only handled in TransformSelect, while subqueries, joins and set operations call TransformSelectNode directly and so transform a pivot SelectStmt as an ordinary select.
reason: The fix moves exactly this added pivot dispatch into TransformSelectNode; seeing that nested selects bypass TransformSelect, although the grammar change accepts PIVOT in any select_clause, needs the other transformer files.

defect: The early return checks get.table_filters.filters.empty() instead of !empty(), so filter pushdown into a GET is skipped exactly when no filters were pushed yet (and the pending filters are dropped).
reason: The fix inverts exactly this added condition; the comment next to it already says the branch is meant for GETs that already have filters.

defect: In the filter path the result vector is chosen with result.data[local_col_id] (the file column id) instead of the output position id, while the other two loops in the same change use the output index.
reason: The fix changes exactly this added index to result.data[id], so filtered columns no longer land in the wrong (or an out-of-range) result vector.

defect: The new formula clamps the cumulative chunk_count progress at 100 and then adds 100 * cur_file, but chunk_count is never reset per file and cur_file is never advanced, so multi-file scans stall at 100/n percent.
reason: Before the change the cumulative chunk_count gave roughly right multi-file progress; the fix (#11071) repairs the stall in the formula this change wrote by using the real file index; seeing that cur_file is stale needs the rest of the file.

defect: AppendData keeps the dictionary offset in a local variable and writes it back only after the loop, while RemainingSpace(handle) inside the loop reads the stale stored offset, so the overflow decision underestimates used space and strings can overrun the block.
reason: The fix reads and stores the dictionary offset per string, repairing exactly the stale-offset logic this change introduced when moving the offset into the block.

defect: The change adds a recurring.<cte> CTE binding only inside the recursive part and, in bind_basetableref.cpp, looks up cte_references by "recurring.<name>", so a reference to recurring.tbl from another (materialized) CTE dereferences a null shared_ptr.
reason: The fix adds the missing null check in bind_basetableref.cpp for the lookup this commit introduced; in this file the fix only moves the recurring binding into AddCTEBinding.

defect: The named-parameter check uses `entry != default_parameters.end()`, so a macro call errors for every valid named parameter and accepts unknown ones.
reason: The fix inverts exactly this added condition.

defect: The new error messages pass idx_t line numbers (linenr - parse_chunk.size(), linenr) for %d in the printf-style varargs ParserException, which is undefined behaviour and misreads the following %s argument where int and idx_t differ in size.
reason: The fix changes exactly these added format specifiers to %llu; that ParserException formats C varargs with vsnprintf is only visible in exception.hpp/cpp.

defect: Set() keeps only the expanded path list (temp, the set schemas, main, pg_catalog), so current_setting('search_path') built from Get() reports the internal paths instead of the paths the user set, and current_setting('schema') returns NULL.
reason: The fix stores the explicitly set paths and reports them through GetSetPaths, repairing the reported value that this change's rework broke; the reporting lives in settings.cpp.

defect: For variable-size entries AppendToBlock compares the byte offset with block_capacity, which is an entry count (blocks are created with block_capacity entries of entry_size bytes), so blocks are filled only to a fraction of their size.
reason: The fix multiplies exactly this added bound by entry_size; the unit mismatch is visible from the RowDataBlock construction and the fixed-size branch in the same diff.

defect: Prefix::Reduce sets the remaining count to PREFIX_SIZE - n - 1, assuming the prefix node is full, instead of subtracting n + 1 from its actual count.
reason: The fix replaces exactly this added assignment with count -= n + 1.

defect: vdata.validity.SetAllValid(count) allocates a mask for STANDARD_VECTOR_SIZE rows and writes count bits, which overflows the buffer when a nested list child column is appended with more than STANDARD_VECTOR_SIZE elements.
reason: The fix removes exactly this added call (a default mask is already all valid); the fixed mask capacity is only visible in validity_mask.hpp.

defect: Changing Equals to take a ConjunctionFilter& means the AND/OR filters no longer override the virtual TableFilter::Equals(const TableFilter&), so comparisons through TableFilter use the base type-only check and treat different conjunctions as equal.
reason: The fix restores the TableFilter& signature on exactly the lines this change altered; the old signature is visible as a removed line in the diff.

defect: single_thread_make_shared allocates an _object_and_block but release() calls `delete ptr` on the embedded object member, deleting a pointer that was not returned by new (undefined behaviour, and wrong for converted base pointers).
reason: The fix makes the block a RefCounter and deletes the whole block through ref_count, replacing exactly this added delete.
